ir.name: loss_sigmoid_ranked_advantage_gap_weighted_entropy
ir.intuition: Shift from pairwise margin models to a pairwise comparison paradigm using sigmoid link with ranking-based advantage signals and entropy regularization. The loss encourages the model to prefer winners with higher advantage gaps while also leveraging the difference in entropy between winner and loser to regularize prediction confidence. Aggregation is a weighted sum emphasizing pairs with larger advantage gaps, diverging structurally from margin-based losses and introducing a ranking and entropy-based signal fusion.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_weight = abs(advantage_gap) / (mean(abs(advantage_gap)) + 1e-8)
rank_factor = rank_gap(delta_rank)
entropy_diff = entropy_l - entropy_w
score = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * entropy_diff
loss_pair = weight * adv_weight * softplus(-score)
loss = sum(loss_pair) / (sum(weight * adv_weight) + 1e-8)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', ops.zeros_like(lpw))
    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', ops.zeros_like(lpl))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))

    adv_abs = ops.abs(advantage_gap)
    adv_weight = adv_abs / (ops.mean(adv_abs) + 1e-8)

    entropy_diff = entropy_l - entropy_w
    score = (lpw - lpl) + beta * entropy_diff

    loss_pair = weight * adv_weight * ops.softplus(-score)

    denom = ops.sum(weight * adv_weight) + 1e-8
    return ops.sum(loss_pair) / denom
